key.name: circle-to-search
key.description: Opens the screenshot tool directly in circle mode.

key.name: tesseract-language
key.description: Language code passed to tesseract -l, for example eng or jpn.

key.name: copy-image
key.summary: Copy the cropped image to the clipboard

key.name: save-file
key.summary: Also save a PNG under Pictures/Screenshots

key.name: show-top-bar
key.description: Adds a Select to Search button to the top bar.

key.name: shake-enabled
key.summary: Shake the pointer to open Select to Search

key.name: shake-sensitivity
key.description: How easily shaking the pointer opens Select to Search. Higher is easier.

key.name: stroke-padding
key.summary: Padding around the stroke, in screen pixels
